fields.m.setting: Room 12 – self-contained ESE classroom, specials, cafeteria, bus line
fields.m.author: Joshua Newsome, M.A., BCBA
fields.m.team: Classroom teacher, two paraprofessionals, SLP, OT, assistant principal, parent
fields.m.fba: FBA in progress – records review (RR-1) and indirect assessment (IA-1) complete; descriptive data being collected on ABC-1 and SP-1
fields.m.plan: BIP due at the annual IEP meeting; this form sets the targets the plan will carry
fields.cand[3].beh: Property destruction (sweeping materials off the desk)
fields.cand[5].beh: Refusal to start work (no response for 30 s)
fields.m.rationale: Six behaviors were nominated across three informants. Prioritization weighted risk of injury first, then interference with instruction, then whether the behavior is a cusp that opens access to less restrictive settings. Four targets are carried forward: one cluster, two single topographies, and one replacement behavior.
fields.clus[0].resp: Block, prompt the break mand and honor it; aggression never ends the demand
fields.clus[0].top[0].f: Hitting an adult with an open or closed hand
fields.clus[0].top[1].f: Kicking an adult below the knee
fields.clus[0].dec: Keep as cluster — all three share an escape function, the same antecedent (independent academic demand), and the same planned consequence
fields.clus[1].resp: Differs by topography — this is what broke the cluster
fields.clus[1].dec: Split into: property destruction (monitor only, tangible) and screaming (monitor only, escape). The two do not share a function or a planned response, so one label would hide the difference.
fields.tgt[0].ctx: Independent academic work in Room 12; occasionally at the bus line
fields.tgt[0].def: Forceful contact of the student’s hand, foot, or head with any part of an adult’s body — audible on contact, leaving a visible mark, or displacing the adult’s body part. Includes contact made while the adult is presenting, prompting, or withdrawing a task.
fields.tgt[0].ex:
Striking the aide’s forearm with an open hand while a worksheet is placed on the desk.
Kicking the teacher’s shin during a hand-over-hand prompt.
Dragging fingernails across an adult’s wrist as the adult reaches for the task materials.
A single light but audible slap to the adult’s shoulder when told “first work, then tablet.”
fields.tgt[0].nex:
Contact made while the adult physically guides the student as part of the agreed escort procedure.
Accidental contact when the student turns quickly and brushes an adult.
Hitting the desk, the wall, or task materials rather than a person.
Reaching toward an adult without contact.
fields.tgt[0].border: Contact through clothing counts if it is audible or displaces the body part. Contact with an adult’s hand while the student pushes materials away counts only if the hand is the point of contact rather than the materials.
fields.tgt[0].excl: Not scored during an approved physical escort. Not scored if the adult initiates the contact.
fields.tgt[0].on: The moment any body part makes contact with the adult
fields.tgt[0].off: 10 s have passed with no further contact
fields.tgt[0].unit: Each contact = 1; a new episode is counted after 10 s without contact
fields.tgt[0].rep: Hands a break card and waits (see target 4)
fields.tgt[0].sv: Teacher and both aides rated the definition as usable without further explanation (4/4 on the classroom survey)
fields.tgt[1].ctx: Independent academic work; occasionally during dressing at home
fields.tgt[1].def: Contact of the student’s open palm with the side or top of the student’s own head, audible from 1 m away or producing visible reddening.
fields.tgt[1].ex:
Striking the right temple once with an open palm during a writing task.
Three rapid open-palm strikes to the top of the head after a demand is repeated.
An audible palm strike to the head while the student is alone at the desk.
fields.tgt[1].nex:
Resting the head in the hands.
Scratching or rubbing the scalp.
Tapping the head lightly with a fingertip, not audible and leaving no mark.
Bumping the head on a surface by accident.
fields.tgt[1].border: A closed-fist strike counts and is noted separately in the comment column. A strike to the head with an object does not count under this definition; it is recorded separately as self-injury with an object.
fields.tgt[1].excl: Not scored during documented illness-related head holding until the nurse clears the student.
fields.tgt[1].on: The moment the palm contacts the head
fields.tgt[1].off: 5 s have passed with no further strike
fields.tgt[1].unit: Each strike = 1; a new episode is counted after 5 s without a strike
fields.tgt[1].rep: Hands a break card and waits
fields.tgt[1].sv: Parent confirmed the definition matches what is seen at home (3/4)
fields.tgt[2].def: Moving more than 2 m from the assigned area without adult permission, or crossing the classroom threshold to leave the room without permission.
fields.tgt[2].ex:
Walking out of the classroom door during independent math.
Leaving the cafeteria table and moving to the far wall without asking.
Stepping into the hallway mid-transition and continuing past the neighboring door.
fields.tgt[2].nex:
Moving to the agreed calm corner, which is inside the assigned area.
Leaving the area with adult permission, including a granted break.
Standing up beside the desk without moving away.
Walking to the bathroom on the posted schedule.
fields.tgt[2].border: A granted break to the calm corner is never elopement. If permission is requested and refused and the student leaves anyway, it counts.
fields.tgt[2].excl: Not scored during a fire drill or any evacuation.
fields.tgt[2].on: The moment the student passes 2 m from the assigned area or crosses the threshold
fields.tgt[2].off: The student has returned to the assigned area and remained for 60 s
fields.tgt[2].unit: Each departure = 1; a new episode is counted once the student has returned and remained for 60 s
fields.tgt[2].rep: Hands a break card and waits
fields.tgt[2].sv: Team agreed the 2 m criterion is workable in both rooms (4/4)
fields.tgt[3].ctx: Every independent academic demand in Room 12
fields.tgt[3].def: Picking up the break card and placing it in the adult’s open hand, or within 15 cm of the adult on the desk, within 10 s of a demand and without a physical or gestural prompt.
fields.tgt[3].ex:
Lifting the card from the desk corner and handing it to the aide when a worksheet is presented.
Placing the card on the adult’s open palm after the teacher says “time for writing.”
Sliding the card to the edge of the desk nearest the adult while looking at the adult.
fields.tgt[3].nex:
Touching the card without moving it.
Handing the card over only after the adult points at it (scored as prompted).
Saying “no” or pushing materials away without using the card.
Handing the card over more than 10 s after the demand.
fields.tgt[3].border: A card handed over during an ongoing aggression episode is still scored, and the break is honored; the aggression is recorded separately.
fields.tgt[3].excl: Not scored when no demand was presented.
fields.tgt[3].on: The card leaves the desk surface toward the adult
fields.tgt[3].off: The card is in the adult’s hand or within 15 cm of the adult
fields.tgt[3].unit: Opportunities = demand presentations; scored as independent, prompted, or absent
fields.tgt[3].sv: Teacher rated the response as easy to honor within 2 s during instruction (4/4)
fields.ioa[0].n: 1 of 20 intervals disagreed (a brush against the aide during a transition); the accidental-contact non-example settled it, no edit
fields.ioa[1].n: 2 of 20 intervals disagreed (light palm touches to the head); the audible-from-1-m criterion settled them, no edit
fields.ioa[3].n: 1 of 13 demands disagreed (prompted vs. independent); the 10 s window added the day before settled it, no edit
fields.rev[0].c: Initial definition drafted from the records review
fields.rev[1].c: Added the audible / visible-mark criterion after two disagreements
fields.rev[2].c: Changed from “leaves the room” to the 2 m / threshold rule
fields.rev[3].c: Added the 10 s window so prompted trials are scored separately
